arr.note: Fastest B2B SaaS to $100M ARR (15 months from $1M)

headcount.note: Still cited at ~300 at merger close; company stays lean

releases.title: Anysphere founded
releases.detail: Michael Truell, Sualeh Asif, Aman Sanger, and Arvid Lunnemark incorporate in San Francisco.

releases.title: Cursor editor launches
releases.detail: Public launch of the AI code editor, a VS Code fork.

releases.title: Seed + $1M ARR
releases.detail: $8M seed led by OpenAI Startup Fund. Hits $1M ARR.

releases.title: Series A — $400M
releases.detail: $60M round led by Andreessen Horowitz.

releases.title: Acquires Supermaven
releases.detail: AI code-completion startup (Jacob Jackson) folded into Cursor.

releases.title: Series B — $2.6B
releases.detail: $105M led by Thrive Capital and a16z.

releases.title: $100M ARR
releases.detail: 15 months from $1M ARR — among the fastest B2B SaaS ramps on record.

releases.title: Claude 3.7 MAX
releases.detail: Full-context, higher tool-call agent mode for longer coding tasks.

releases.title: Series C — $9.9B · $500M ARR
releases.detail: $900M led by Thrive Capital.

releases.title: Agents on web, mobile, Slack · Bugbot
releases.detail: Coding agents leave the IDE. Bugbot launches for GitHub PR review.

releases.title: Cursor Agent CLI
releases.detail: Agent available from the command line.

releases.title: Cursor 2.0 + Composer
releases.detail: First in-house agentic coding model. Multi-agent interface via git worktrees.

releases.title: Series D — $29.3B · $1B ARR
releases.detail: $2.3B co-led by Accel and Coatue. Google and NVIDIA participate. In-IDE browser ships.

releases.title: Graphite acquisition
releases.detail: Code-review startup acquired in a cash-and-equity deal above Graphite’s $290M valuation.

releases.title: Cloud Agents · $2B ARR
releases.detail: Async remote agents. Bloomberg reports $2B ARR. Composer 1.5 ships.

releases.title: Cursor in JetBrains (ACP)
releases.detail: Joins Agent Communication Protocol registry; live inside JetBrains IDEs.

releases.title: Composer 2
releases.detail: Frontier-level coding model at $0.50/M input. Trained from Kimi K2.5 + RL.

releases.title: Cursor 3
releases.detail: Agent-first rebuild; no longer a VS Code fork. Parallel local and cloud agents.

releases.title: Remote agents + code review agent
releases.detail: Review agent claimed to catch 78% of issues before merge.

releases.title: SpaceX $60B option
releases.detail: SpaceX can buy Cursor for $60B later in 2026, or pay $10B for joint work.

releases.title: Cursor SDK
releases.detail: Runtime, harness, and models that power the IDE, embeddable in other products.

releases.title: Composer 2.5 · $3B ARR
releases.detail: Long-horizon agentic gains. Bloomberg: $3B annual sales rate.

releases.title: SpaceX acquisition announced
releases.detail: All-stock merger agreement. Cursor to join SpaceXAI.

releases.title: Production-trained router
releases.detail: Router trained on production traffic: Intelligence / Balance / Cost modes.

releases.title: Merger close
releases.detail: Cursor becomes a wholly owned SpaceX subsidiary. 389.3M SPCX Class A shares issued.

ownershipEstimate.disclaimer: Anysphere did not publish a cap table. Employee equity (16.2% fully diluted) is derived from the 8-K award conversions. Founder and investor slices are a reconstruction from disclosed round sizes and subsequent dilution, not a filing.

sources.title: SpaceX Form 8-K — completion of Cursor merger
